question: Which of the following fraction is the smallest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the LCM of the numerators (27, 81, 9, 3) which is 81.

Make all numerators equal to 81: 27/512 = 81/1536, 81/1535 = 81/1535, 9/170 = 81/1530, 3/70 = 81/1890.

When numerators are identical, the fraction with the largest denominator is the smallest.

Comparing denominators: 1890 > 1536 > 1535 > 1530.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/70.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fractions: 27/512, 81/1535, 9/170, and 3/70

**Concept Used:**

Cross-multiplication method: For two fractions a/b and c/d, if a × d > b × c, then a/b > c/d.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Compare 27/512 and 81/1535:

⇒ 27 × 1535 = 41445 and 81 × 512 = 41472

⇒ Since 41445 1536, we get 27/512 > 3/70.

⇒ Therefore, 3/70 is the smallest fraction among all.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/70.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cross Multiplication Method

To quickly compare two fractions a/b and c/d, compute a × d and b × c. If a × d > b × c, then a/b > c/d. This avoids lengthy decimal calculations.

Numerator Equating Trick

When fractions have easily convertible numerators, find their LCM and equate all numerators by multiplying accordingly. The fraction with the largest denominator becomes the smallest overall fraction.

Denominator Equating Trick

Find the LCM of the denominators and convert all fractions to this common denominator base. The fraction with the largest numerator will represent the greatest value.
